Humeral shaft fractures: 3

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

Months after a humeral shaft fracture, the patient still has pain and abnormal movement at the fracture site. Serial radiographs show no meaningful healing progression. Which complication should trigger evaluation of mechanical stability and biological factors?

  1. Nonunion
  2. Joint stiffness
  3. Osteonecrosis
  4. Post-traumatic osteoarthritis
  5. Acute compartment syndrome
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Nonunion

Persistent failure of fracture healing requires assessment of stability, biology, infection and patient factors.

Understanding the options

Nonunion
Persistent failure of fracture healing requires assessment of stability, biology, infection and patient factors.
Joint stiffness
Capsular contracture, adhesions and prolonged immobilization can restrict motion after injury. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Osteonecrosis
Disruption of blood supply can lead to death and collapse of an injured bony segment. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Post-traumatic osteoarthritis
Articular incongruity or cartilage damage can cause later degenerative joint changes. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Acute compartment syndrome
Rising compartment pressure impairs perfusion; escalating pain and pain on passive stretch require urgent assessment. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
